🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](\(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatodoCerrado2025/register) tab.

If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M). 

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

items.name: Boards & Cubes Venteira III 2025
items.information:
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](hhttps://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63095-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63096-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 10%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63099-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63095-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63096-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 10% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63099-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•

## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
